title: Implement Request Logging with Error Handling
description: This feature will provide detailed request logging with error handling to help diagnose and debug issues in production. It will log each incoming request and any errors that occur during processing, allowing for better monitoring and maintenance. This will improve the overall reliability and maintainability of the yantraverse framework.
testCases: Test error logging during request processing
acceptance: Requests are logged with relevant details, and errors during request processing are properly logged and handled without crashing the server.
reason: Improved logging and error handling are crucial for a production-ready framework, enabling developers to identify and fix issues efficiently.
